name: SPSampleKit
summary: A minimal, production-shaped iOS SDK, shipped as a prebuilt XCFramework.
description:
SPSampleKit is a small iOS framework that shows the structure of a publishable
SDK: a configured singleton entry point, a delegate for callbacks, typed errors,
bundled resources resolved correctly at runtime, and a drop-in UIKit view. This
podspec distributes it as a closed-source XCFramework rather than as source.
